title: porcelain dipping bowls
text: porcelain dipping bowls. These are nice... handy for sauces... snack cups... I actually use these for my grandson's salsa.  A really useful size... not too small.. not to large. Thick, dishwasher safe, sturdy.  The cup part holds about 1/4 to 1/3 cup of food, depending on what you're putting in it. I will update my review should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: DOWAN Soy Sauce Dish, Charcuterie Bowls, 3 Oz Dipping Bowls with Handles, Small Bowls for Side Dish, Dipping, Serving, Spice, Sauce, Ingredient, Mini Tiny Bowls
features: Charcuterie Bowls for Dipping: DOWAN Sauce bowls are the appropriate size for dips and sauces that can be shared in parties and breakfast. Small bowls for side dishes, appetizer, condiment, snack, olive, and more in BBQ, buffet, and party dinner.

Easy to Handle with Spout: Comfortable handle on bowl makes it easy to transfer dumplings and Xiao Long Bao from steamer and add your sauces. The spout is handy for serving or passing around, avoiding fingers accidentally getting into the sauces.

High-quality Porcelain: Dowan dip bowls are made of top grade porcelain and fired at a high temperature to maximize the strength of the porcelain. Compared with plastic, the sauce bowl is safer for holding hot food or even microwave ramekin use.
Easy to Clean and Space-saving: Dishwasher, microwave, freezer, and oven safe. These sauce cups were deep and heavy enough to stay sturdy on a level surface without wobbling over.
Well-designed Package : No worries about the Porcelain quality and packaging. Each sauce dish is individually wrapped for transport protection and secure they all were inside the box they came in.
